git.readme:
# TempDesk answer files

Exported from the TempDesk answer file builder on {0}.

- autounattend.xml: the current answer file.
- versions/: {1} saved versions, oldest first.

To keep history in Git:

    git init
    git add .
    git commit -m "Answer files"

Answer files can contain passwords in Windows unattend encoding (not encryption). Keep this repository private.
h.adminPassword: Written in Windows unattend encoding (base64), which is not encryption. Erase the media after installing.
h.autoLogonCount: 0 turns automatic sign-in off. The first account (or Administrator) is used.
h.computerName: 1 to 15 letters, numbers or hyphens. Leave empty on guest PCs for a random name.
h.dnsMode: The domain join runs during specialize, so DNS must already point to the domain controller. Use a DHCP option (006) or set it here.
h.dnsServers: Usually 127.0.0.1, because this server becomes the DNS server. Separate several with commas.
h.domainName: A DNS name you control, for example lab.example.org. Avoid .local.
h.dsrmPassword: Used to repair Active Directory offline. Store it somewhere safe.
h.features: Feature names separated by commas, for example Microsoft-Hyper-V-All, Containers. Server uses Install-WindowsFeature names such as RSAT-AD-Tools.
h.functionalLevel: Leave empty for the server default. Win2025 needs every domain controller to run Windows Server 2025.
h.imageIndex: The index depends on the ISO. Check it with: dism /Get-WimInfo /WimFile:D:\sources\install.wim (use install.esd if that is what the ISO has).
h.joinUser: A dedicated account that can only join computers to the domain.
h.keyboard: A language tag such as en-US, or an input locale such as 0409:00000409.
h.netbiosName: Suggested from the domain name. Up to 15 characters.
h.ou: Leave empty for OU=Computers,OU=TempDesk under your domain, which the TempDesk computer policy is linked to.
h.portalsMode: Native hosts both portals on this server without Docker (ports 8081 and 8082). None leaves them for a Docker host.
h.productKey: Leave empty to use the key on the media or activate later.
h.x_apps: Installs machine-wide with winget at the first sign-in. Needs internet access.
h.x_ntpServer: For example time.windows.com or pool.ntp.org. Domain members normally sync from the domain controller.
